title: Takes a lot of effort to use
text: Takes a lot of effort to use. It seems to take an unreasonable amount of effort to pump out the foam soap. I've followed the instructions for soap to water ratio, but it feels like the pump is clogged.

product_metadata.title: iDesign Foaming Soap Dispenser for Kitchen, Bathroom, Sink, Vanity, 3" x 3" x 7.5", Clear and Brushed Nickel
features: HAND SOAP DISPENSER – This iDesign liquid soap dispenser holds up to 14 ounces of your favorite brand of soap; it’s a perfect soap holder and better alternative to single-use plastic bottles for the master bathroom, kitchen, guest or kid’s bathroom

DURABLE – The durable, clear plastic construction keeps this bathroom soap dispenser looking new for years of use; the sturdy base prevents the soap dispenser pump from tipping over or sliding on a wet counter

STYLISH – The modern brushed nickel accent matches a variety of bathroom decorations and any color bathroom set; it’s the perfect addition to bathroom accessories and organizers and can also be a dish soap dispenser

IDEAL SIZE – The foam soap dispenser measures 3" x 3" x 7.5" to fit perfectly on any countertop; and it can be used with any brand or type of liquid soap, dish soap, or hand sanitizer as well as a lotion dispenser

IDESIGN: iDesign offers innovative bathroom storage products at a reasonable price; we’re a global leader in housewares with a mission to make every day easier with innovative products designed to help people organize and enhance their homes with style
description: Add style and functionality to your sink with the iDesign Slate Collection Soap Dispenser. Hand soap is a house organization must have, and this reusable soap pump provides a better alternative to single-use plastic bottles and is made for use with any brand of hand soap, dish soap, lotion, or hand sanitizer. The versatile design of this soap saver can be used in the bathroom, kitchen, laundry room, and more. To refill the hand soap dispenser pump, simply take off the pump and pour your favorite liquid soap, lotion, or hand sanitizer into the bottle. Made with durable clear plastic with a stylish brushed nickel pump head, the clear surface of the dispenser lets you easily see when it’s time to refill. Measuring 3" x 3" x 7.5" with a 14 oz. capacity, this refillable soap dispenser is ideal for use in compact spaces on countertops. With iDesign, you can live simply and sustainably every day.
The InterDesign Foaming Soap Pump is an economical way to use liquid soap. Simply combine soap and water to create luxurious foaming soap. Works great in the kitchen or bath!
